summary.en: BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual entry in Video

description.en:
BenchCouncil lists VideoMAE in the Video area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “VideoMAE: Masked Autoencoders are Data-Efficient Learners for Self-Supervised Video Pre-Training”. The page names Zhan Tong, Limin Wang as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.

本 Archive 记录保留官方行序、引用数、机构和国家字段。它表示 2022-2023 年度入选记录，与长期 canonical AI100 故事线分开维护。
